claims: No. 6 seed Notre Dame defeated No. 2 seed Vanderbilt 67-64.
The game was in the 2026 Women’s NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
Hannah Hidalgo recorded a triple-double with 31 points, 11 rebounds, 10 steals.
Mikayla Blakes scored 26 points on 7-of-26 shooting for Vanderbilt.
Vanderbilt rallied late in the fourth quarter.
The win sent Notre Dame to the Elite Eight for the first time under coach Niele Ivey.
The game was held at Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, Texas.
